name: The Standard
description: Gives a newcomer explanation, fill-in templates and one document that shows end to end how a solution is shaped and how to adopt that shape in another repository, so a person or an agent can apply ESOI by hand before any tool is installed. Its metric is the one where the best is a newcomer reaching a passing application by reading alone.
purpose: Teach anyone, person or AI, how a solution is shaped and how a project adopts it, with explanation and fill-in templates that need no code.
approach: Lay out the shape of a solution and the steps to adopt it in documents that can be followed alone: explain each idea in plain words and provide templates that can be filled in without code.
out_of_scope: What the automated checks already enforce; making an agent act by the principles.
milestones: 1. Adoption effort: one recorded newcomer trial of following only the standard in a fresh repository. 2. Newcomer effort: one recorded run of a newcomer following the guides in a fresh repository.
measures_of_success: Someone following it alone reaches a passing check. Standing conditions: One document gives the shape of a solution end to end and the steps to adopt it elsewhere; A newcomer can write an overall network and a first solution from the templates alone.
inputs: The registry's rules and examples; the skill's SKILL.md.
outputs: The standard document, explanations, guides and generated templates.
usage_notes: Read the explanation first, then copy a template; update the standard in the same change as any rule.
